name: Vergessen ist nicht vergangen
summary:
As a digger who makes ends meet with construction work, thus avoiding mining, you experience daily miserable wages and humiliations at the hands of the guards. Brabak, their leader, has a particular vendetta against you and has already ensured that your trust test failed in the past. After a particularly painful protection money payment, you realize that things can't continue this way. You're prepared to do anything to climb the pecking order and strike a deal with Diego that lets you do things no digger has ever dreamed of...

Story takes place in the Mining Valley on Khorinis. The story was inspired by the Gothic comic (Gothic: Der Comic). You'll learn what happened shortly before the nameless hero's arrival and why the Old Camp's situation in Gothic 1 is the way it is.

The mod team aimed to preserve the Gothic 1 style. New features were added very sparingly, and those that made it into the mod were heavily adapted to G1. The rough tone between the diggers and the guards was also increased, reinforcing the feeling of a weak and defenseless digger fighting his way through a dog-eat-dog society.
